dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Approximately 3-4 irregular, light-toned annular structures with jagged perimeters; one prominent closed loop is located posterior to the pectoral flipper, and a complex 'C' shaped structure is visible in the mid-dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent mid-dorsal ring, the ring posterior to the flipper, and a third faint lateral loop form a wide-angled obtuse triangle.

other_distinctive_markers: The right pectoral flipper displays five distinct, dark, segmented digit-like structures with clear spatial separation at the distal margins.
